listing.name: Super Smash Bros. Brawl / BrawlRecompiled
listing.summary: Explore BrawlRecompiled and follow the upstream project for original-game requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Keep a permitted prepared player
steps.instruction: For an existing permitted copy of the reviewed Windows package, keep Brawl Recompiled.exe, engine and Disc together and choose Brawl Recompiled.exe with its folder as the working directory. The Linux package has its own Brawl Recompiled launcher, 64-bit Linux and Vulkan requirements. Save launch details without starting the player; choose Play separately.

steps.title: Use the launcher for your own disc
steps.instruction: On the launcher’s Play page choose your own USA RSBE01 revision 1 Brawl ISO, CISO or WBFS. It extracts Disc/DATA (about 7 GB) and checks the disc identity. No original disc is supplied by Portcove. The prebuilt runtime needs no compiler.

steps.title: Keep the complete player-data tree
steps.instruction: You or upstream provide updates for this external copy. Back up engine/UserData, including settings, NAND saves, SD/mod content and generated card images; retain Disc and your original image separately. Custom disc/NAND paths need their own backup. Use a new permitted version separately and preserve the current working copy. Portcove does not adopt external files or promise managed Update, Backup or Rollback.
